_comment: Film 69 Mirelo SFX 2.0 (mirelo-ai/sfx2.0/text-to-audio, 0.01 USD/s, 2 samples each, 2026-11-24). Files in /tmp/claude-0/f69/audio/sfx, not in the repo. kit_snap = sample 1 (seed 6901), 0.9-1.7 s; pieces_scatter = sample 2 (seed 6903), 0.33-1.53 s. Everything else from sfx-bibliothek (akzent: paper_slide, shimmer_rings, tick -> clock_tick = 0.15-1.65 s). No atmo beds: SFX only in the gaps, never under a running sentence.

kit_snap.negative_prompt: music, voices, crowd, wind noise, hiss
kit_snap.prompt: A single solid wooden puzzle piece of a construction kit clicks firmly into its slot on a wooden board: one short clean click-snap with a tiny hollow wooden resonance. Close, clean, quiet room, no music, no voices.

pieces_scatter.negative_prompt: music, voices, crowd, wind noise, hiss, glass
pieces_scatter.prompt: A handful of small wooden construction-kit pieces is gently tipped out and scatters across a wooden table: a short soft rattle of many small wooden pieces settling, then stillness. Close, clean, quiet room, no music, no voices.
